name: Veg Gyoza
steps: Knead flour, half the salt and 140 ml hot water into smooth dough. Cover and rest for 20 minutes.
Finely chop vegetables and aromatics. Sauté in sesame oil for 6 minutes until dry; add half the soy and remaining salt, then cool.
Divide dough into 24 pieces, roll thin circles, add filling and pleat into tightly sealed crescents, pressing out air.
Brown bases in oil for 3 minutes. Add remaining water, cover and steam 7 minutes; uncover to crisp. Serve with remaining soy and vinegar.
tips: Cover unused dough to prevent the wrappers drying and splitting.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
